A thousand see it. A hundred and twenty click. Thirty six leave a contact. Eighteen pick up the phone. Nine book a call. Three buy.

Every single stage lost people. That is not broken — that is what a funnel is.

The problem is never that a funnel narrows. The problem is not knowing which stage narrows too much, because the fix is completely different depending on where the leak is.

Few clicks is an offer problem. Clicks with no contacts is a page problem. Contacts nobody answers is a speed problem. Calls that don't close is a price or positioning problem.

Most businesses respond to all four the same way: spend more. That only fixes the first one.

📌 Send this to someone about to raise their budget without knowing which stage is broken.
